# Venn diagram of ASVs

a. Venn diagram of different genotypes of ASVs; b. Venn diagram of different pig breeds of ASVs. Black circle outlines represent different groups.

(GG: *GG* genotype, GA: *GA* genotype, AA: *AA* genotype; D: Duroc; Y: Yorkshire; L: Landrace)

## Load packages

```{r}
#| label: venn-load-packages
#| message: false
#| warning: false
library(tidyverse)
library(ggVennDiagram)
library(patchwork)

theme_set(theme_void())
```

## Prepare ASV sets

```{r}
#| label: venn-prepare-sets
otu_table <- read.csv("data/amplicon-sequencing/otu_table_mt.csv", row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE)
sample_table <- read.csv("data/amplicon-sequencing/sample_table_mt.csv", row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE) |>
  rownames_to_column("sample") |>
  mutate(
    genotype = factor(genotype, levels = c("GG", "GA", "AA")),
    breed = factor(breed, levels = c("Duroc", "Yorkshire", "Landrace"))
  )

asv_sets_by_group <- function(group_var, labels) {
  sample_table |>
    filter(!is.na(.data[[group_var]])) |>
    group_by(.data[[group_var]]) |>
    summarise(samples = list(intersect(sample, colnames(otu_table))), .groups = "drop") |>
    mutate(
      asvs = map(samples, function(sample_ids) {
        rownames(otu_table)[rowSums(otu_table[, sample_ids, drop = FALSE] > 0) > 0]
      }),
      group_label = labels[as.character(.data[[group_var]])]
    ) |>
    select(group_label, asvs) |>
    deframe()
}

genotype_sets <- asv_sets_by_group(
  "genotype",
  c(GG = "GG", GA = "GA", AA = "AA")
)

breed_sets <- asv_sets_by_group(
  "breed",
  c(Duroc = "D", Yorkshire = "Y", Landrace = "L")
)

venn_colors <- rep("black", 3)
```

## Venn diagram

```{r}
#| label: fig-venn-asv
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 6
#| fig-cap: "Venn diagram of ASVs. a. Venn diagram of different genotypes of ASVs; b. Venn diagram of different pig breeds of ASVs."
plot_venn <- function(sets, title) {
  ggVennDiagram(
    sets,
    label_alpha = 0,
    set_color = venn_colors,
    set_size = 5,
    label = "count"
  ) +
    scale_fill_gradient(low = "#F7FBFF", high = "#2B6CB0") +
    labs(title = title) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0, size = 13),
      legend.position = "none"
    )
}

plot_venn(genotype_sets, "a. Genotype") +
  plot_venn(breed_sets, "b. Pig breed") +
  plot_layout(ncol = 2)
```
